system.description: A Focus for incredible physical strength, powerful leaps, and smashing through obstacles.

abilities.name: Always Mighty
abilities.description: Restore one extra Might point whenever a recovery restores Might, up to three selections.

abilities.name: Hitting Harder
abilities.description: Your unarmed attacks deal 1 additional damage.

abilities.name: Inspiring Display
abilities.description: After succeeding at a brute-force task, restore 2 points to an ally’s Pool or 2 health to an NPC ally who saw you.

abilities.name: Feat of Strength
abilities.description: After a successful brute-force task, ease an ally’s next task or hinder or intimidate a foe who saw you.

abilities.name: Desperate Feat
abilities.description: While you have a moderate or major wound, gain 1 Edge in a Pool of your choice.

abilities.name: Naturally Strong
abilities.description: On a carry, climb, jump, or smash task, treat a roll below 9 as a 9; the minimum rises to 12 at tier 3. Renews after a recovery.

abilities.name: Deep Reserves
abilities.description: Transfer up to 6 points among your Pools at 1 point per round; the ability renews after a ten-hour recovery.

abilities.name: Iron Fist
abilities.description: Your unarmed attacks deal 3 additional damage.

abilities.name: Amazing Strength
abilities.description: When you use Might Effort on a noncombat task, gain one free level of Effort.

abilities.name: Throw
abilities.description: When your unarmed attack damages a creature your size or smaller, throw it 1d20 feet and leave it prone.

abilities.name: Brute Strike
abilities.description: When you hit with a Might attack, deal 6 additional damage; you cannot use this in consecutive rounds.

abilities.name: Brute Squad
abilities.description: Perform two Might tasks this turn, one with your normal action and one with an extra action.

abilities.name: Jump Attack
abilities.description: Jump up to 4 feet and make a melee attack; on a hit, you can deal 4 extra damage and knock the target prone.
